svg.text: Mirror CP: which rank computes which tokens
Prefill only · one sequence of 8 tokens, no cached context · cp = 2 · commit 9bd9cf2
parts = 2 x cp = 4 part size ps = ceil(8 / 4) = 2 cp_mirror_len = 2 x ps = 4 rows per rank
Rank r takes part r and part 2cp-1-r. Each rank gets one early part and one late part.
query rows: t0 t1 t6 t7
query rows: t2 t3 t4 t5
mirror_cp_reverse_index = [0, 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 2, 3]: row of token i in the gathered tensor [rank 0 rows | rank 1 rows].
What does each rank do in the step?
Each rank computes its own rows. Two kinds of all-gather give every rank the full KV and the full output.
embed all tokens, then keep own rows
attention: project K/V for own rows
[2 x 4, ...] -> reorder with reverse index -> full KV [8, ...]
store full KV, attend for own 4 queries
each CP rank keeps the whole KV; queries stay [4, heads, d]
MoE on own rows (EP dispatch / combine)
[4, H] per rank; padding rows have valid_token_mask = False
after the last layer: all-gather hidden
H = hidden size (from the checkpoint, not in the repo). Steps 2-4 run in every attention layer; one CP session per layer.
With cached context or several sequences, each sequence is split the same way, one after the other (prepare_cp_mirror.py:143-156).
Decode steps do not use this layout: every CP rank gets the same decode batch (attn.py:766).
